Use a color in the `style` argument, for example `console.print("Hello", style="#ff8700")`. Rich supports hex colors; terminals with limited color support use the closest available color. See [Styles](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst). If you meant a new feature beyond styling text, describe the behavior you need and discuss it first in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
